title_en: 2 Apartments 1+1 for SALE in the Former End Station of New Tirana
description_en: 2 Apartments 1+1 for SALE in the Former Terminal Station of New Tirana Near the school 26 Nentori 3rd floor without elevator, pallat i vitti 1992 | Areas respectively 57m² and 45m² Organization: Living room + kitchen, 1 bedroom, balcony, corridor and toilet. The apartments have been recently restored, laid with parquet, new plumbing and electrical system, patina, doors, windows and hydrosanitary. With certificates of ownership. The apartments are located in one of the most sought-after areas for both residence and investment. 58m² - 118,000€ and 47m² - 104,000€ are sold respectively.
